_doc: IPA → Vietnamese spelling rules, used by src/lib/vi.ts to read the pronunciation aloud with a Vietnamese voice. Vietnamese has tones and many Wu sounds (ng-, nh, ư, ơ, đ, gi). Every change needs a test in tests/vi.test.ts. Initials are matched longest first; finals (rhymes) are matched whole. The finals from ʮ on (and ɓ, ɗ, x, n̩, m̩) are for the Qingtian tables.
_ignoredSuffixes: Final glottal stop of the Qingtian checked tones 7/8: Vietnamese has no -ʔ coda, the nặng tone carries it.
_tones: Per dialect. Vietnamese: ngang (none), huyền (grave), sắc (acute), ngã (tilde), nặng (dot below), hỏi (hook). Wencheng uses the Wenzhou contours (zh.wikipedia 温州话): 1=33 2=31 3=45ʔ 4=34ʔ 5=42 6=11 7=313 8=213. Qingtian contours from the MCPDict Qingtian county survey (青田YB): 1=445 2=21 3=454 4=343 5=33 6=22 7=42ʔ 8=31ʔ. 0=neutral.
